title: feat(layout): AppShell & Navigation Renderer (P0.1)
body:
Last P0 blocker — enables rendering a fully-functional sidebar + navigation tree from `AppSchema` JSON.

### New components (`packages/layout`)

- **`NavigationRenderer`** — Renders `NavigationItem[]` into Shadcn sidebar. All 7 nav types (object, dashboard, page, url, report, action, group), separators, badges, collapsible groups, sort-by-order, active route highlighting.
- **`AppSchemaRenderer`** — Consumes `AppSchema` JSON → complete app shell. Branding, area switcher, legacy `menu` migration, slot props (`navbar`, `sidebarFooter`).
- **Mobile nav modes** — `drawer` (default), `bottom_nav` (fixed bottom bar), `hamburger`.
- **Permission & visibility guards** — Decoupled via callbacks (`evaluateVisibility`, `checkPermission`) so layout stays independent of specific permission/expression providers.

### Usage

```tsx
<AppSchemaRenderer
  schema={appJson}
  basePath="/apps/sales"
  mobileNavMode="bottom_nav"
  evaluateVisibility={(expr) => evaluateVisibility(expr, evaluator)}
  checkPermission={(perms) => perms.every(p => can(p))}
  sidebarFooter={<UserProfileMenu />}
>
  <Outlet />
</AppSchemaRenderer>
```

### Tests

38 new tests (20 NavigationRenderer + 18 AppSchemaRenderer). Full suite passes (296 files, 5206 tests, 0 regressions).

### Roadmap

Updated `ROADMAP.md` — all P0.1 items marked complete.
